verdict.rationale: GPU backend choice is a fair question for a local inference runtime like Ollama, so the axis applies. The evidence only mentions ROCm-based AMD support, including ROCm containers and a ROCm-missing fallback to CPU. Nothing in the pack documents a Vulkan backend or AMD acceleration without ROCm.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can accelerate inference on AMD GPUs via a Vulkan backend without needing a full ROCm install
